correctness.rationale: For any fixed positive half-sides and small offset, eight exact signed heights reduce the section polygon to cube-edge sign changes. Every pentagon has exactly one near-zero height pair. Spherical coarea gives the three strip areas with no quadratic term, local strip overlap triangles give the exact quadratic penalty, and strict convexity yields unique fixed-diagonal cubic equality. The standalone full 12-edge enumerator agreed on 16,800,000 trials; numerical tests are secondary to the explicit derivations.

value.rationale: The natural event of an odd-sided polygon appearing when a central section is displaced detects symmetry breaking. The universal first derivative at fixed diagonal is structurally surprising; the first shape-dependent term is exact and sharply optimized only by the cube. This gives a complete infinitesimal extremal statement, nontrivial coarea/overlap geometry, and clear application as a stereological shape statistic. It does not claim a full inversion or uniform aspect-ratio stability.
